question: How does sacrifice-created humanity procreate and attain liberation?
premises: lord of beings created beings with sacrifice
actions give world-cycle or liberation by attachment or detachment
inference: sacrifice-grounded action sustains progeny and yields either bondage or liberation depending on attachment
uncertainties: fused sandhi tokens are glossed as wholes
plain_english: Having created beings with sacrifice, the lord of beings said that through it they should procreate; beings were created together with actions, and actions yield either world-cycle through attachment or liberation through detachment.
